fields.beta_input: >= 126 unguarded daily returns in the line's last 252 panel sessions
fields.cik: universe cik (panel link, else link_table_v3 as of)
fields.idio_vol_input: >= 15 unguarded daily returns in the line's last 21 panel sessions
fields.me: universe me (shares_daily shrout x raw close)

codes_on_all_common.criterion: shrcd_like and exchcd_like on >= 99% of all_common cells, each year 2020-2025

daily_band.criterion: all_common names/day (yearly mean) in [3200, 4800] each year 2020-2025

daily_no_price_screen.criterion: all_common_no_price_screen names/day (yearly mean) in [3200, 4800] each year 2020-2025

french_nyse.criterion: NYSE all_common lines within +-5% of French ME-breakpoint NYSE count, each month <= 2022-12

hand_check.criterion: flags >= 95% precise on a 100-line hand check

r2000.criterion: univ_r2000p companies in [1900, 2100] on each reconstitution's first effective session
